title: Crop rotation and intercropping guide
context: Smallholder farmers and extension workers need plain-language, source-cited guidance on crop rotation and intercropping.
objective: Write a plain-language guide to crop rotation and intercropping summarizing established practice: why it matters, the practice, common mistakes, and sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers crop rotation and intercropping as established general practice
General educational guidance only; no farm-specific prescriptions or pesticide dosing
Cites >=2 authoritative open sources with links
